Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to submit our offer for your consideration. We can offer you a price of €5.74 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, and a contract term of 12 months.

As a valued partner, we always strive to support your operations with our extensive inventory and reliable delivery service. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our successful business relationship and standing by as your trusted partner for all your supply needs.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for explaining your position.

Our data shows a different picture on some points:
Your rolling scorecard shows on-time delivery of 88.6% (sc:70610@2026Q3).
Our demand forecast for this part has risen 15.3% (fc:360011@2026-09).

Please find our proposal below.

We look forward to your reply.

Kind regards

Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. However, we checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We appreciate the increased volume forecast and are pleased to support a 24-month contract, which allows us to improve our pricing. While we note your comments on delivery performance, we are actively optimizing our logistics to ensure the highest reliability.

We can accept your proposed payment terms of 45 days and offer a revised price of €5.53 per unit. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

Our Angebot consists of a price of €5.53 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your revised offer and are pleased to support a 36-month contract to ensure long-term supply stability.

As Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH, we take pride in our extensive range and dependable service. Our main offer stands at a price of €5.46 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 36 months. 

However, a 90-day payment term exceeds our standard parameters. We propose a compromise of 60 days net, which allows us to offer a further reduced price of €5.42 per unit. Specifically, this alternative package features a price of €5.42 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 36 months.

Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

move.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you very much for your continued interest in our products and for working with us during these negotiations. We appreciate your flexibility in accepting the 60-day payment term.

To reach an agreement, we are prepared to lower our price to €5.36 per unit for the 36-month contract. This represents a significant concession and reflects our commitment to building a strong partnership. Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2594, LCI-C.

Please note that our offer is a price of €5.36 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 36 months. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. This Angebot stays valid for 7 days.

We look forward to hearing from you soon and hope to continue serving your needs.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

decisions.tactician: o5 (pay 45 d, 24 months) has the lowest C of all options, below E0 (pay 60 d, 36 months), and its value to the supplier is essentially the same. It keeps a two-year commitment, which suits a supplier with idle capacity, without locking us in for three years. Payment at 45 d is close to its 30 d standard, so it costs the supplier little. The OTD argument (a1) and the strongest forecast-growth argument (a3) push for price and volume value while using only one volume_change claim.

decisions.tactician: o1 and o2 give the lowest C among options other than o8, almost the same as o8. o2 adds a thirty-six-month commitment that answers the supplier's volume question and its idle-capacity need without changing our C. That makes it more likely than E0 to draw a further move. Accepting at €5.53 now would leave about €29k on the table, and the supplier's steady pace suggests it will keep conceding. No unused arguments remain.

decisions.tactician: E0 keeps the supplier's own preferred terms (60 days, 36 months), so the only open point is price. The 36-month term also suits it, though that value is not counted in its cash comparison. Our C would drop from about €325k on its best sheet to about €311k. The 14-day options (o1, o2) save only about €450 more but reverse the payment terms it just proposed, which adds friction for little gain. o9's twelve-month term is far worse for us. Its recent pace (about one reply to reach our level) suggests a deal near this price is reachable. Its status is open, not final, so pushing once more is reasonably safe. No arguments are left that it has not already heard.
